test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: 8 boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 4 boys are sitting at each corner, and 4 boys are sitting at the middle of each side of the table. A is an immediate neighbour of H and G. A is sitting at a corner. B is an immediate neighbour of D and C. E is an immediate neighbour of C and F. G is third to the right of D. Three out of the following four options follow a similar rule and form a group. Which of the following does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
Step 1: A is an immediate neighbour of H and G. A is sitting at a corner.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46a4e1ff996984cd080e4b32c4a8f81cb1182dac54ba73c1d355164a63ae307a.png] We place A at one corner and then place G and H to it's immediate spots.

Step 2: G is third to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31f05ac534e8dd86d5886784c17dca73757c483dd9326f6bd2b75f60b14b45c3.png] Now we place D to the third left of G.

Step 3: B is an immediate neighbour of D and C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf52194ec7a2be8108358a4a030ab49631a33db8c77e61a0d2bd94f72b2ef2ea.png] Here we place B next to D and then C next to B.

Step 4: E is an immediate neighbour of C and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fba5b1c8c620e30656bacafa064d27ed7e2b63970f9177fe655e1114e593008e.png] Lastly we place E next to C and F next to E.

With the help of this diagram, we check the relation between given options:

Option 1) EB : There is only one person between them.

Option 2) BH : There is only one person between them.

Option 3) AF : There is only one person between them.

Option 4) GC : There is two people between them. 

Thus **GC is the odd pair.**

**Hence,** **the correct answer is option 4)**
